name: v10.1.0
body:
`v10.0.1`, adds backward-compatible features:

- Recursive license detection via `detect --recursive`
- Line-based diff output via `diff --line-diff`
- `pyproject.toml` license matching
- Partial (license ID extraction only) compound SPDX-expression support
- Several bug fixes and vendored-license updates
